summary: Implemented the code change in src/humanize/lists.py: natural_list now takes items: Iterable[Any] (Iterable imported from collections.abc inside the existing TYPE_CHECKING block), builds item_list = [str(item) for item in items] once, then formats only from that list (empty -> "", one -> item, two -> "a and b", more -> ", ".join(all but last) + " and last"). Docstring updated to "Convert an iterable of items" / "items (Iterable): An iterable of items." I verified all tests/test_lists.py cases pass by loading the module directly (list, tuple, dict.keys, generator, range, empty, ints). However the required check command .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_lists.py fails with exit 127: this worktree contains no .venv, and I cannot create it because network/package-cache installs fail (uv offline cannot find hatch-vcs/pytest; ~/.cache/uv is read-only).
concerns: The .venv is missing from the worktree; tests were validated by importing src/humanize/lists.py directly, not via pytest
src/humanize/_version.py is generated at build time and absent, so `import humanize` fails even with PYTHONPATH=src
Only src/humanize/lists.py is modified; no protected file was touched
